description: Shared org preset for tpsdev-ai repositories. Establishes the supply-chain posture: pin version updates, enforce a 7-day bake-time cooldown, and group non-major PRs so review surface stays small. Every update is proposal-only (automerge: false) — it must pass the full CI suite + K&S review before merge. See docs/supply-chain-policy.md.

packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates (minor, patch, pin, digest) into a single PR per run so the review surface stays small. Each still goes through the full test suite + K&S review before merge — automerge is off.
Major updates land as their own PRs — they carry the most behavioral risk and deserve isolated review.
Group GitHub Actions into a single PR so sub-actions land together. CodeQL rejects mixed versions across sub-actions (bob#58/#99), so all codeql-action sub-actions must land in one PR.
Pin digests for Docker managers to lock the image content; prevents supply-chain drift from republished image tags.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month
